explication: WTF is a terminal-based personal information dashboard. Users configure modules, launch the app, and view selected information in a terminal interface; module clients fetch data from external services. The README documents the configurable-module workflow and highlights DigitalOcean, GitHub, Google Calendar, Hacker News, HIBP, New Relic, OpsGenie, Security, and Transmission. The excerpts show startup configuration and several service clients, but not how the app registers or renders modules, so those internal links are left out.
